title: Code by Zapier fails with 'Scripting payload too large' or the 250 item output limit
symptoms: You cannot return more than 250 items from a Code action
cause: Code steps run on AWS Lambda with a 6 MB cap on code plus data, and output is limited to 250 items. A fetch chain without a catch can also exit silently.
fix: Return only the fields you need, split large arrays across steps, and await fetch inside try and catch.
affected: Code by Zapier JavaScript and Python, all plans, as of 2026-10
